translations.en.sahih: The Inevitable Reality -
translations.en.pickthall: The Reality!
translations.en.yusufali: The Sure Reality!
translations.id.indonesian: Hari kiamat,

translations.en.sahih: What is the Inevitable Reality?
translations.en.pickthall: What is the Reality?
translations.en.yusufali: What is the Sure Reality?
translations.id.indonesian: apakah hari kiamat itu?

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
translations.en.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is!
translations.en.yusufali: And what will make thee realise what the Sure Reality is?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tahukah kamu apakah hari kiamat itu?

translations.en.sahih: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity.
translations.en.pickthall: (The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come.
translations.en.yusufali: The Thamud and the 'Ad People (branded) as false the Stunning Calamity!
translations.id.indonesian: Kaum Tsamud dan 'Aad telah mendustakan hari kiamat.

translations.en.sahih: So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
translations.en.pickthall: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning.
translations.en.yusufali: But the Thamud,- they were destroyed by a terrible Storm of thunder and lightning!
translations.id.indonesian: Adapun kaum Tsamud, maka mereka telah dibinasakan dengan kejadian yang luar biasa.

arabic: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
transliteration: Wa ammaa 'Aadun fa uhlikoo bireehin sarsarin 'aatiyah

translations.en.sahih: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
translations.en.pickthall: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind,
translations.en.yusufali: And the 'Ad, they were destroyed by a furious Wind, exceedingly violent;
translations.id.indonesian: Adapun kaum 'Aad maka mereka telah dibinasakan dengan angin yang sangat dingin lagi amat kencang,

arabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
transliteration: Sakhkharahaa 'alaihim sab'a la yaalinw wa samaaniyata ayyaamin husooman fataral qawma feehaa sar'aa ka annahum a'jaazu nakhlin khaawiyah

translations.en.sahih: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
translations.en.pickthall: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees.
translations.en.yusufali: He made it rage against them seven nights and eight days in succession: so that thou couldst see the (whole) people lying prostrate in its (path), as they had been roots of hollow palm-trees tumbled down!
translations.id.indonesian: yang Allah menimpakan angin itu kepada mereka selama tujuh malam dan delapan hari terus menerus; maka kamu lihat kaum 'Aad pada waktu itu mati bergelimpangan seakan-akan mereka tunggul pohon kurma yang telah kosong (lapuk).

translations.en.sahih: Then do you see of them any remains?
translations.en.pickthall: Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them?
translations.en.yusufali: Then seest thou any of them left surviving?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka kamu tidak melihat seorangpun yang tinggal di antara mereka.

arabic: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
transliteration: Wa jaaa'a Firawnu wa man qablahoo wal mu'tafikaatu bilhaati'ah

translations.en.sahih: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
translations.en.pickthall: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error,
translations.en.yusufali: And Pharaoh, and those before him, and the Cities Overthrown, committed habitual Sin.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan telah datang Fir'aun dan orang-orang yang sebelumnya dan (penduduk) negeri-negeri yang dijungkir balikkan karena kesalahan yang besar.

arabic: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
transliteration: Fa'ansaw Rasoola Rabbihim fa akhazahum akhzatar raabiyah

translations.en.sahih: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
translations.en.pickthall: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip.
translations.en.yusufali: And disobeyed (each) the messenger of their Lord; so He punished them with an abundant Penalty.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka (masing-masing) mereka mendurhakai rasul Tuhan mereka, lalu Allah menyiksa mereka dengan siksaan yang sangat keras.

arabic: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
transliteration: Innaa lammaa taghal maaa'u hamalnaakum fil jaariyah

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship
translations.en.yusufali: We, when the water (of Noah's Flood) overflowed beyond its limits, carried you (mankind), in the floating (Ark),
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami, tatkala air telah naik (sampai ke gunung) Kami bawa (nenek moyang) kamu, ke dalam bahtera,

arabic: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
transliteration: Linaj'alahaa lakum tazki ratanw-wa ta'iyahaa unzununw waa'iyah

translations.en.sahih: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
translations.en.pickthall: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember.
translations.en.yusufali: That We might make it a Message unto you, and that ears (that should hear the tale and) retain its memory should bear its (lessons) in remembrance.
translations.id.indonesian: agar Kami jadikan peristiwa itu peringatan bagi kamu dan agar diperhatikan oleh telinga yang mau mendengar.

arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
transliteration: Fa izaa nufikha fis soori nafkhatunw waahidah

translations.en.sahih: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
translations.en.pickthall: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast
translations.en.yusufali: Then, when one blast is sounded on the Trumpet,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apabila sangkakala ditiup sekali tiup

arabic: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
transliteration: Wa humilatil ardu wal jibaalu fadukkataa dakkatanw waahidah

translations.en.sahih: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow -
translations.en.pickthall: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash,
translations.en.yusufali: And the earth is moved, and its mountains, and they are crushed to powder at one stroke,-
translations.id.indonesian: dan diangkatlah bumi dan gunung-gunung, lalu dibenturkan keduanya sekali bentur.

translations.en.sahih: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur,
translations.en.pickthall: Then, on that day will the Event befall.
translations.en.yusufali: On that Day shall the (Great) Event come to pass.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka pada hari itu terjadilah hari kiamat,

translations.en.sahih: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
translations.en.pickthall: And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail.
translations.en.yusufali: And the sky will be rent asunder, for it will that Day be flimsy,
translations.id.indonesian: dan terbelahlah langit, karena pada hari itu langit menjadi lemah.

arabic: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ
transliteration: Wal malaku 'alaaa arjaaa'ihaa; wa yahmilu 'Arsha Rabbika fawqahum yawma'izin samaaniyah

translations.en.sahih: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
translations.en.pickthall: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them.
translations.en.yusufali: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight will, that Day, bear the Throne of thy Lord above them.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan malaikat-malaikat berada di penjuru-penjuru langit. Dan pada hari itu delapan orang malaikat menjunjung 'Arsy Tuhanmu di atas (kepala) mereka.

arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
transliteration: Yawma'izin tu'radoona laa takhfaa min kum khaafiyah

translations.en.sahih: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
translations.en.pickthall: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden.
translations.en.yusufali: That Day shall ye be brought to Judgment: not an act of yours that ye hide will be hidden.
translations.id.indonesian: Pada hari itu kamu dihadapkan (kepada Tuhanmu), tiada sesuatupun dari keadaanmu yang tersembunyi (bagi Allah).

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
transliteration: Fa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenihee fa yaqoolu haaa'umuq ra'oo kitaabiyah

translations.en.sahih: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
translations.en.pickthall: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book!
translations.en.yusufali: Then he that will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Ah here! Read ye my Record!
translations.id.indonesian: Adapun orang-orang yang diberikan kepadanya kitabnya dari sebelah kanannya, maka dia berkata: "Ambillah, bacalah kitabku (ini)".

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
translations.en.pickthall: Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning.
translations.en.yusufali: "I did really understand that my Account would (One Day) reach me!"
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya aku yakin, bahwa sesungguhnya aku akan menemui hisab terhadap diriku.

translations.en.sahih: So he will be in a pleasant life -
translations.en.pickthall: Then he will be in blissful state
translations.en.yusufali: And he will be in a life of Bliss,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka orang itu berada dalam kehidupan yang diridhai,

translations.en.sahih: In an elevated garden,
translations.en.pickthall: In a high garden
translations.en.yusufali: In a Garden on high,
translations.id.indonesian: dalam surga yang tinggi,

translations.en.sahih: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
translations.en.pickthall: Whereof the clusters are in easy reach.
translations.en.yusufali: The Fruits whereof (will hang in bunches) low and near.
translations.id.indonesian: buah-buahannya dekat,

arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
transliteration: Kuloo washraboo haneee'am bimaaa aslaftum fil ayyaamil khaliyah

translations.en.sahih: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
translations.en.pickthall: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days.
translations.en.yusufali: "Eat ye and drink ye, with full satisfaction; because of the (good) that ye sent before you, in the days that are gone!"
translations.id.indonesian: (kepada mereka dikatakan): "Makan dan minumlah dengan sedap disebabkan amal yang telah kamu kerjakan pada hari-hari yang telah lalu".

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
transliteration: Wa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo bishimaalihee fa yaqoolu yaalaitanee lam oota kitaaabiyah

translations.en.sahih: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
translations.en.pickthall: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book
translations.en.yusufali: And he that will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "Ah! Would that my Record had not been given to me!
translations.id.indonesian: Adapun orang yang diberikan kepadanya kitabnya dari sebelah kirinya, maka dia berkata: "Wahai alangkah baiknya kiranya tidak diberikan kepadaku kitabku (ini).

translations.en.sahih: And had not known what is my account.
translations.en.pickthall: And knew not what my reckoning!
translations.en.yusufali: "And that I had never realised how my account (stood)!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan aku tidak mengetahui apa hisab terhadap diriku.

translations.en.sahih: I wish my death had been the decisive one.
translations.en.pickthall: Oh, would that it had been death!
translations.en.yusufali: "Ah! Would that (Death) had made an end of me!
translations.id.indonesian: Wahai kiranya kematian itulah yang menyelesaikan segala sesuatu.

translations.en.sahih: My wealth has not availed me.
translations.en.pickthall: My wealth hath not availed me,
translations.en.yusufali: "Of no profit to me has been my wealth!
translations.id.indonesian: Hartaku sekali-kali tidak memberi manfaat kepadaku.

translations.en.sahih: Gone from me is my authority."
translations.en.pickthall: My power hath gone from me.
translations.en.yusufali: "My power has perished from me!"...
translations.id.indonesian: Telah hilang kekuasaanku daripadaku".

translations.en.sahih: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
translations.en.pickthall: (It will be said): Take him and fetter him
translations.en.yusufali: (The stern command will say): "Seize ye him, and bind ye him,
translations.id.indonesian: (Allah berfirman): "Peganglah dia lalu belenggulah tangannya ke lehernya.

translations.en.sahih: Then into Hellfire drive him.
translations.en.pickthall: And then expose him to hell-fire
translations.en.yusufali: "And burn ye him in the Blazing Fire.
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian masukkanlah dia ke dalam api neraka yang menyala-nyala.

arabic: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
transliteration: Summa fee silsilatin zar'uhaa sab'oona ziraa'an faslukooh

translations.en.sahih: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
translations.en.pickthall: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits.
translations.en.yusufali: "Further, make him march in a chain, whereof the length is seventy cubits!
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian belitlah dia dengan rantai yang panjangnya tujuh puluh hasta.

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous,
translations.en.yusufali: "This was he that would not believe in Allah Most High.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya dia dahulu tidak beriman kepada Allah Yang Maha Besar.

translations.en.sahih: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
translations.en.pickthall: And urged not on the feeding of the wretched.
translations.en.yusufali: "And would not encourage the feeding of the indigent!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan juga dia tidak mendorong (orang lain) untuk memberi makan orang miskin.

translations.en.sahih: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
translations.en.pickthall: Therefor hath he no lover here this day,
translations.en.yusufali: "So no friend hath he here this Day.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka tiada seorang temanpun baginya pada hari ini di sini.

transliteration: Wa laa ta'aamun illaa min ghisleen

translations.en.sahih: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
translations.en.pickthall: Nor any food save filth
translations.en.yusufali: "Nor hath he any food except the corruption from the washing of wounds,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tiada (pula) makanan sedikitpun (baginya) kecuali dari darah dan nanah.

translations.en.sahih: None will eat it except the sinners.
translations.en.pickthall: Which none but sinners eat.
translations.en.yusufali: "Which none do eat but those in sin."
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak ada yang memakannya kecuali orang-orang yang berdosa.

translations.en.sahih: So I swear by what you see
translations.en.pickthall: But nay! I swear by all that ye see
translations.en.yusufali: So I do call to witness what ye see,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Aku bersumpah dengan apa yang kamu lihat.

translations.en.sahih: And what you do not see
translations.en.pickthall: And all that ye see not
translations.en.yusufali: And what ye see not,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan dengan apa yang tidak kamu lihat.

translations.en.sahih: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger.
translations.en.pickthall: That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger.
translations.en.yusufali: That this is verily the word of an honoured messenger;
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Al Quran itu adalah benar-benar wahyu (Allah yang diturunkan kepada) Rasul yang mulia,

arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
transliteration: Wa ma huwa biqawli shaa'ir; qaleelam maa tu'minoon

translations.en.sahih: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
translations.en.pickthall: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe!
translations.en.yusufali: It is not the word of a poet: little it is ye believe!
translations.id.indonesian: dan Al Quran itu bukanlah perkataan seorang penyair. Sedikit sekali kamu beriman kepadanya.

arabic: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
transliteration: Wa laa biqawli kaahin; qaleelam maa tazakkaroon

translations.en.sahih: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
translations.en.pickthall: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember!
translations.en.yusufali: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer: little admonition it is ye receive.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan bukan pula perkataan tukang tenung. Sedikit sekali kamu mengambil pelajaran daripadanya.

translations.en.sahih: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.pickthall: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.en.yusufali: (This is) a Message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds.
translations.id.indonesian: Ia adalah wahyu yang diturunkan dari Tuhan semesta alam.

translations.en.sahih: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
translations.en.pickthall: And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us,
translations.en.yusufali: And if the messenger were to invent any sayings in Our name,
translations.id.indonesian: Seandainya dia (Muhammad) mengadakan sebagian perkataan atas (nama) Kami,

translations.en.sahih: We would have seized him by the right hand;
translations.en.pickthall: We assuredly had taken him by the right hand
translations.en.yusufali: We should certainly seize him by his right hand,
translations.id.indonesian: niscaya benar-benar Kami pegang dia pada tangan kanannya.

translations.en.sahih: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
translations.en.pickthall: And then severed his life-artery,
translations.en.yusufali: And We should certainly then cut off the artery of his heart:
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian benar-benar Kami potong urat tali jantungnya.

arabic: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
translations.en.pickthall: And not one of you could have held Us off from him.
translations.en.yusufali: Nor could any of you withhold him (from Our wrath).
translations.id.indonesian: Maka sekali-kali tidak ada seorangpun dari kamu yang dapat menghalangi (Kami), dari pemotongan urat nadi itu.

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil).
translations.en.yusufali: But verily this is a Message for the Allah-fearing.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Al Quran itu benar-benar suatu pelajaran bagi orang-orang yang bertakwa.

transliteration: Wa inna lana'lamu anna minkum mukazzibeen

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it).
translations.en.yusufali: And We certainly know that there are amongst you those that reject (it).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Kami benar-benar mengetahui bahwa di antara kamu ada orang yang mendustakan(nya).

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers.
translations.en.yusufali: But truly (Revelation) is a cause of sorrow for the Unbelievers.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Al Quran itu benar-benar menjadi penyesalan bagi orang-orang kafir (di akhirat).

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! it is absolute truth.
translations.en.yusufali: But verily it is Truth of assured certainty.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Al Quran itu benar-benar kebenaran yang diyakini.

translations.en.sahih: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
translations.en.pickthall: So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord.
translations.en.yusufali: So glorify the name of thy Lord Most High.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka bertasbihlah dengan (menyebut) nama Tuhanmu Yang Maha Besar.
